title: Button
description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

support.notes: Five sizes; solid/outline/ghost/link; semantic colors; loading text; leading/trailing icon slots; native submit/reset; disabled; active; full width; shape/radius. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

vars.name: --button-height
vars.description: Minimum height (every size; defaults to the density's control height of the size)

vars.name: --button-radius
vars.description: Corner radius (defaults to --radius-md; the shape / borderRadius props win)

vars.name: --button-gap
vars.description: Space between the icons and the label

vars.name: --button-label-white-space
vars.description: White-space of the label: nowrap (default, truncates) or normal (wraps)

translationResources.title: Button
translationResources.description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Click the button to increase the visible count by one.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color sets the semantic color: primary (default), neutral, success, warning, danger or info.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant sets the visual style: solid (default), outline, ghost or link. It combines with any color.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Five sizes: xsmall, small, medium (default), large and xlarge.

shapes.title: Shapes and radius
shapes.description: Preset shapes, or a custom borderRadius preset / pixel value.

states.title: States
states.description: Loading, disabled and active states. Loading blocks clicks (and form submission) while an action is running, but keeps keyboard focus on the button.

with-icon.title: With icons
with-icon.description: Combine text and icons with startIcon / endIcon, e.g. a danger retry or a neutral ghost back button. Give icon-only buttons an aria-label.

icons-loading.title: Icons, loading text and full width
icons-loading.description: startIcon / endIcon render icons around the label, loadingText replaces the content while loading and fullWidth stretches the button.

form.title: In a form: type
form.description: Button defaults to type="button", so a Button inside a <form> (preview, add row, open dialog...) never submits it by accident. Pass type="submit" for the submit button and type="reset" to reset the form.

ButtonProps.type: Native button type. Defaults to "button" (unlike the HTML default "submit"), so a Button in a form never submits it by accident: use type="submit" for submit buttons and "reset" for reset buttons
ButtonProps.onClick: Called when the button is clicked (not called while disabled)
ButtonProps.variant: Visual style: solid (filled), outline (border only), ghost (transparent until hovered) or link (text link look)
ButtonProps.aria-label: Accessible label, required when the button only contains an icon
ButtonProps.loading: Shows a spinner and blocks activation (aria-busy / aria-disabled). The button stays focusable so keyboard focus is not lost
ButtonProps.active: Renders the button in its pressed/active state
ButtonProps.borderRadius: Corner radius: a preset or a number of pixels. The theme radius (--radius-md) is used when omitted
ButtonProps.loadingText: Text shown instead of the content (and icons) while loading
ButtonProps.fullWidth: Stretches the button to the full width of its container

cssVars.--button-height: Minimum height (every size; defaults to the density's control height of the size)
cssVars.--button-radius: Corner radius (defaults to --radius-md; the shape / borderRadius props win)
cssVars.--button-gap: Space between the icons and the label
cssVars.--button-label-white-space: White-space of the label: nowrap (default, truncates) or normal (wraps)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Click the button to increase the visible count by one.

colors-variants.title: Colors and variants
colors-variants.description: color sets the semantic tone (shared ColorScheme), variant the visual style.

sizes-shapes.title: Sizes and shapes
sizes-shapes.description: Five sizes and three shapes. Icon-only circle buttons need an aria-label, forwarded to the inner button.

states.title: States, icons and loading
states.description: The start / end slots hold icons, the loading slot replaces the label while loading. Click Save to see the loading state.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The element is form-associated: type="submit" validates and submits its form, type="reset" resets it.

slots.loading: Text shown instead of the label while loading.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner button.
methods.click: Clicks the inner button (ignored while disabled or loading).
